_comment: Example sqli per-column display settings. The live file is .sqli/sqli_formatting.json (written by the app, safe to hand-edit; gitignore it). Shape: databases > <host:port/db> > tables > <table> > { hidden:[cols], order:[cols], widths:{col:width}, formats:{col:formatId} }. The key is the whole connection, not just the database name — 'devel' on two servers are two different databases and keep separate entries. A socket connection keys as <socket-path/db>. Delete any key to reset it. Validate with `php sqli.php --lint`.
